title: MISP contains an authorization bypass in the correlations/eventCorrelations endpoint and the… (CVE-2026-132637)
description: MISP has an authorization bypass vulnerability in the correlations/eventCorrelations endpoint and its correlation engines. Authenticated users can access full correlation results of events from other organizations without proper permission checks. This includes sensitive threat intelligence attribute values and identifiers that should be restricted. The flaw allows disclosure of otherwise hidden event data and confirmation of event existence. Exploitation requires a valid authenticated session and knowledge or enumeration of a target event ID. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.3.
